decision: The exact frozen035 source/config implements the bounded endpoint-exchange diagnostic. Static clearance is not native execution or response-match acceptance.

state_exchange.M: All mean_model.* state entries, including full shared feature network and mean buffers.
state_exchange.R: All other state entries: basis_head, charge_head, envelope_head and local_filter.
state_exchange.construction: Rebuild each corner directly from the two original endpoint state dictionaries, then strict-load; no cumulative parameter arithmetic.
state_exchange.endpoint_binding: Pinned034 initial/final bytes; runtime schema0/2000/config/stats/scales/dataset/frozen005 checks and initial full-model digest. Optimizer is not restored or used.
state_exchange.eval_versus033_train: The current response029/response008 forward graph has no BatchNorm, dropout, train-mode forward branch or mutable running statistics. GroupNorm is mode invariant and all stochastic draws are explicit. eval() introduces no train/eval calculation difference in this graph. Native replay remains an execution check.
state_exchange.cached_A_only: A0/Af reuse base_signal_pre_V from M0R0/MfRf, with the same cached electronics and hard observation; zero additional NN calls.
state_exchange.A_only_scoring: Primary data energy only, no inherited random regularizer or full-objective total. Saturation is descriptive.
state_exchange.shared_feature_boundary: M changes decoded/pooled features and A amplitude supplied to fixed R. These are functional endpoint exchanges, not isolated deterministic-output interventions.
state_exchange.cross_R_mean_check: Save A_cross_R_absmax from existing corner outputs without extra forwards.

noise_observation.banks: The eight previously examined033 TRAIN risk banks, excluding its first-gradient bank.
noise_observation.streams: Four independent NumPy SOURCE A/B and REAL T/U streams, six distinct Torch response/noise005/extension A/B streams per bank. All80 explicit seeds unique.
noise_observation.cache: make_bank once per bank caches indices, response latents,005 noise, three-H extensions and targets for all six states.
noise_observation.REAL_contract: One CPU existing-carrier observation for21047 already-digitized TRAIN rows; bitwise window256/baseline100 checks; use prepared window as authoritative target. No second ADC, filtering or DEV.
noise_observation.generated_contract: Original hard ADC/argmax/crop through observe_generated_carrier(ste=False), three hypotheses; each flag denominator128.
noise_observation.units: Imported SAMPLE_INTERVAL_NS=1.0 in software coordinates, not hardware calibration. observedQ uses obs[Q]; negative areas multiply imported dt once.

objective_statistics.data_formula: Unchanged033 energy_parts through031: mean six standardized joint wave-view energies +2*joint signed-asinh integral energy +.25*joint centered-carrier energy; cross and replica-self pairs retained.
objective_statistics.corner_total: Data+.01*(model regular+saturation), with mean/basis/charge/local regular decomposition and per-H totals. A-only excludes model regular/full totals.
objective_statistics.paired_order: Within-bank contrast first, then mean and sample-SD(ddof=1)/sqrt(8) MCSE. Interaction=Eff-Ef0-E0f+E00.
objective_statistics.B_voltage_RMS: Per parent sqrt(mean(B^2) across8 basis channels and384 samples), followed by parent-distribution summary.
objective_statistics.B_RMS_over_A_RMS: Per parent B_voltage_RMS divided by sqrt(mean(A^2) over384 samples), followed by summary of those ratios; not peak ratio or ratio of global summaries.
objective_statistics.feature_hook: Read-only UNet hook on the same64 corner calls; removed in finally. Decoded/pooled RMS requires no additional forward.
objective_statistics.geometry: Pure pre-ADC A and stochastic signal canonicalQ, negative area, carrier RMS, peaks, support and residual saturation use existing outputs.

resource_enforcement: Existing check_limits covers wall/output; RSS is enforced by external supervise.py --rss-limit-gib 12;10GiB GPU allocator bound; external supervisor/project lock required; no automatic restart.
success_and_limits: Engineering success requires pinned execution, all48 state-bank records, paired summaries and exact counters. This static review establishes no native result.
Reused TRAIN diagnostic banks are not fresh confirmation, DEV testing or candidate selection.
A-only deterministic mean network plus electronics is not the conditional mean of nonlinear hard-observed waveforms.
Endpoint exchanges may locate functional mean/random/shared-feature interactions. They do not prove training-history cause or hard-FD/STE gradient mechanism.
No response-match gate is added or relaxed; conditional kernel recovery and fit success remain unestablished.
scope: Source, preparation/configuration JSON and saved aggregate manifest metadata only; no project import, CP bytes/deserialization, original arrays, NN, AD or observation.
